# Pinned Gold Platform discovery fixture

`gold_platform.json` is copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/blob/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/decorations/common/gold_platform.json

`sha256.json` records its exact source bytes. Native adaptations are the
recipe ID, `recipe` to `recipes`, and `tag` to `items: "#tag"`.
